revisions.reason: Freeze project-level lifecycle hook skill toolkit as an independent P1 feature from v1.4.10 research
Normalize PRD scope heading for requirement closure gate recognition
Normalize TC-HOOK-004 layer to automated gate coverage

items.text: Hook contracts live under `docs/beacon/hooks/<hook-id>.md`; version directories only hold research and requirement material.
Each hook is a single Markdown file with frontmatter and human-readable sections for purpose, admission, evidence, and failure route.
Hooks are limited to `post_implement_pre_qa`, `qa_diagnostics`, `post_qa_pre_release`, and `post_release`.
Hook admission validates lifecycle binding, enabled state, skill availability, command template, trigger policy, required evidence, and failure route; side-effect hooks require manual confirmation.
Hook runs write `.beacon/state/hooks/<hook-id>/<run-id>.json` and `docs/beacon/.machine/hooks/<hook-id>.latest.json` as evidence/read models only.
Operators can list, plan, dry-run, confirmed-run, disable, and inspect hook status without editing machine projections directly.
The contract covers Beacon post-release local install, Rolo post-implement UAT, and Rolo QA Debug Lab as fixtures, not global defaults.
Hooks cannot rewrite PRD, user-story, test-case, freeze state, QA verdict, release verdict, or gate verdict.
Hidden auto-run, arbitrary shell hooks, unknown hook codes, and missing failure routes fail closed with explicit reason codes.
Implement current frozen revision

Verify AC-004 — Hook admission validates lifecycle binding, enabled state, skill availability, command template, trigger policy, required evidence, and failure route; side-effect hooks require manual confirmation.
Verify AC-005 — Hook runs write `.beacon/state/hooks/<hook-id>/<run-id>.json` and `docs/beacon/.machine/hooks/<hook-id>.latest.json` as evidence/read models only.
Verify AC-006 — Operators can list, plan, dry-run, confirmed-run, disable, and inspect hook status without editing machine projections directly.
Verify AC-007 — The contract covers Beacon post-release local install, Rolo post-implement UAT, and Rolo QA Debug Lab as fixtures, not global defaults.
Verify AC-008 — Hooks cannot rewrite PRD, user-story, test-case, freeze state, QA verdict, release verdict, or gate verdict.
Verify AC-009 — Hidden auto-run, arbitrary shell hooks, unknown hook codes, and missing failure routes fail closed with explicit reason codes.

decision_priority: Hook 是 project-level extension，不是 version-level feature artifact。
Hook contract 固定在 `docs/beacon/hooks/<hook-id>.md`。
Hook 必须绑定有限 hook code，不允许任意时机隐式触发。
Hook 必须有 contract、admission、dry-run 和 evidence。
项目特有动作不得硬编码成 Beacon 全局默认。
涉及全局安装、UAT 发布、pipeline、写数据的 hook 必须 `manual_confirmed`。
Hook 输出只能作为 runtime / delivery / QA support evidence，不能改 requirement truth。
Hook failure 必须有 failure family 和 route，不得静默跳过。
`beacon.config.yaml` 不能成为 hook truth 的第二份副本。
